autonomy_horizon: One Bangumi capability and episode graph preview slice through closeout. Keep graph depth as preview evidence until refresh guard tests prove the persistence boundary.
auto_advance_rule: Run BRED-020 first. Auto-advance into BRED-030 only after Bangumi capability claims are endpoint-backed. Auto-advance into BRED-040 and closeout only if graph preview stays non-mutating. Do not enter schema, Public Client API, Admin/Web, or Generated Artifact apply changes.
checkpoints: after Bangumi capabilities stop overclaiming season/episode support
after Bangumi endpoint-backed episode graph preview is added
after tests prove episode graph depth does not create child Media Items or Provider Mappings during refresh
after lane closeout or follow-on split
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata bangumi_provider metadata_candidate --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata bangumi refresh metadata_candidate --no-fail-fast when refresh guard changes
stop_conditions: child Provider Mapping writes from graph preview
raw Bangumi response or secret exposure
closeout_notes: Keep Bangumi depth preview-only unless a later durable review or Admin/Web lane changes persistence semantics.
